rows.question: What has Ralston been working on lately in his personal-website repository?
rows.rule: calls recent_commits(personal-website); answers from the commits; claim check passes
rows.answer: Recent commits in personal-website (all dated 2026-11-09) add a voice feature to the site's /ask/ page: a local voice server, recorder and file picker on /ask/, an /api/voice endpoint that transcribes, answers through askCore and speaks the answer, plus a browser check. The same day he added a week 7 eval with fixture transcripts across two models, two spoken answers and one real turn, recorded in CHECKS.md, and a test-first fix so email addresses are spoken as words. The project itself is described as a shipped one-page portfolio in plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript on GitHub Pages, with a live contributions heatmap and a printable résumé.
